paper.title_en: Logarithmic corrections to the entropy of near-extremal black holes in New Massive Gravity
paper.abstract_en: We study the one-loop correction to the entropy of near-extremal black holes in three-dimensional massive gravity at the special point where the theory exhibits a unique maximally symmetric vacuum and non-constant curvature hairy black holes can achieve extremality even in the static case. Focusing on the near-horizon AdS$_2\times S^1$ geometry, we evaluate the contribution of boundary graviton modes that become exact zero modes in the extremal limit. We show that the resulting one-loop partition function generates logarithmic corrections to the semiclassical entropy, providing a new extension to higher-curvature gravity of what has been recently obtained for near-extremal black holes in General Relativity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在三维新大规模引力中研究近极端黑洞熵的一圈对数修正确，将广义相对论中已有的结果推广到高阶曲率引力，理论深度突出、问题明确，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 新大规模引力中近极端黑洞熵的对数修正
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了三维大规模引力中近极端黑洞熵的一圈修正，所考察的是该理论具有唯一极大对称真空、且非恒定曲率毛发黑洞即使在静态情形下也能达到极端性的特殊点。聚焦于近视界的 AdS$_2\times S^1$ 几何，我们计算了在极端极限下成为精确零模的边界引力子模式的贡献。我们表明，所得的一圈配分函数会对半经典熵产生对数修正，从而将近期在广义相对论近极端黑洞中获得的相应结果以新的方式推广到高阶曲率引力。
